summary.intent: Assess and plan CipherBox Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability), audit todo backlog drift from phases 70/70.1/71, then discovered and fixed three CI regressions and web-e2e test flakiness before resuming Phase 72 planning and execution.
summary.outcome: Merged two regression-fix PRs (#600 web-e2e/sdk-e2e fixes, #601 FUSE equivocation fix), stabilized 4 flaky web-e2e tests via local CI-equivalent-regime verification, then completed Phase 72 research/pattern-mapping/planning/plan-check and executed Wave 0 (3/10 plans, all gates green) with Wave 1 (72-04) in progress when the session ended.

repo: CI E2E workflow (ci-e2e.yml, runs Web+Desktop E2E) triggers only on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch — never on PRs; validate pre-merge via `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`, which 422s on this repo's older workflow definition)

Playwright's ciFloor() helper raises waits to a 60s floor only under CI; local runs use much tighter per-test timeouts (15-30s), causing tests that pass reliably in CI to flake locally on a loaded/cold dev stack

playwright.config.ts webServer.reuseExistingServer is `!process.env.CI`, so setting CI=1 locally to get the 60s floor also refuses to reuse an already-running dev server — must temporarily patch reuse-server config (and revert) to reproduce CI's exact timeout regime locally

Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water, seq-high-water) into one `rotation-floor` store (DB cipherbox-rotation-state v2, keyed by nodeId) — any test helper still probing old store names silently returns undefined instead of erroring

Phase 71 (#599) renamed share DTO fields (readDescriptorRef→encryptedReadKey, writeDescriptorRef→encryptedWriteKey, rootIpnsName→shareRootIpnsName) but left stale references in desktop-e2e .mts test drivers, causing ForbidNonWhitelisted 400s unrelated to the actual product code under test

CI's `pnpm typecheck` only runs each package's tsconfig.build.json, which excludes test files — test-file TypeScript errors (e.g. vitest v2→v3 Mock generics drift) accumulate silently and are never caught in CI

GSD hook config JSON (.claude/gsd-core) contains raw newlines/control characters inside string values, breaking naive JSON.parse and even `--raw` CLI output — requires a custom lenient parser that only escapes control chars inside string literals

Fresh git worktrees in this pnpm monorepo lack node_modules, a known failure mode — for phases heavily serialized on one file (e.g. client.ts), sequential execution on the main tree is more reliable than worktree-isolated parallel execution
Addressed/retired todos live in `.planning/todos/completed/`, not `resolved/` (which is unused/empty)

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on the first-publish branch gated only by 'inode cid empty', so a re-key that changes the CID re-triggers seq=1 and collides with Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate; fix resolves IPNS first and routes Found outcomes into the existing CAS-retry path instead of blindly first-publishing

publish_with_cas_retry gained an optional preresolved_seq param so callers that already resolved the sequence (e.g. the Found path in content_ops.rs) skip a redundant second resolve call; the conflict-retry path always re-resolves since a pre-resolved value goes stale after a conflict

readDurableFloors/writeDurableSeqFloor rewritten to target the collapsed rotation-floor IndexedDB store; writeDurableSeqFloor does read-modify-write to preserve other fields rather than blind overwrite
ciFloor() helper source of the local-vs-CI timeout asymmetry that caused repeated cascading local flakes (4.10, 4.11, 2.1) during flake verification

workflow: When a workflow only runs on push/dispatch (not PRs), dispatch it manually against the fix branch via `--ref` for real pre-merge validation instead of merging blind

To reproduce CI-only timing behavior locally, run under the same CI env flag/timeout regime rather than iteratively bumping individual test timeouts one flake at a time — the latter wastes many cycles chasing a moving target
Bookkeeping changes intended to ride a later commit can be safely stashed, carried across branch switches/rebases, and popped back once the target branch is ready
Capture newly-discovered but out-of-scope work (e.g. CI typecheck gap) as a durable todo file immediately so it survives context compaction, rather than just noting it verbally
For long multi-plan phase execution, set up TaskCreate trackers to persist directives and sequencing decisions (e.g. 'fix all TS drift, do it last') across many background agent completions

friction: Local web-e2e flake verification took 7 iterative re-runs because ciFloor's local/CI timeout asymmetry caused a different test to flake at the front of the serial chain each time, repeatedly blocking the actual target tests (6.6.2, 8.2) from ever executing
`gh workflow run -f ref=` returned HTTP 422 (unsupported input on this repo's workflow definition); had to use `--ref <branch>` instead
Own `git cat-file` verification of HEAD contents was self-contradictory at one point, requiring a redo with a more decisive check
git commit hung ~2 minutes during lint-staged, likely a 1Password SSH signing prompt (known repo issue) — required a manual check to confirm the commit had actually landed
GSD hook fragment extraction from raw JSON failed repeatedly due to embedded control characters, requiring a custom parser script to be written and debugged
AskUserQuestion tool call rendered oddly, prompting the user to ask 'is there anything to clarify' back instead of getting a direct answer choice
